Leaf tips entire underleaves shallow notches no sidelobes, leaves usually broader than long, very occasionally with two teeth, gemmae often prominent at shoot tips, two ranks of overlapping oblong leaves
Leaves tend to be deeply divided with spreading lobes, leaves inserted obliquely or even laterally, no underleaves, bracts of perianths are two-pronged

Opaque bright green with prominent gemmae on leaf tips

species_features: Large thallus with cup shaped gemma receptacles
